text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while training in preparation
for the NHK Mile Cup—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Taiki Shuttle-san. Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Tazuna-san!
Welcome!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's on short notice, but Taiki Shuttle
received an interview request.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, an interview...?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
They said they saw great promise in you from your past races.
So they'd love to run a special feature on you!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Amazing! That is a true honor, yes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "Starting to draw attention is proof that Taiki Shuttle's skill is the real deal—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems we have taken the first step
toward becoming the "Umamusume of the Year."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much!
Well then, I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! I'll do my best for the interview!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Well then, could I get some shots
of you running next?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay!
Let's goooo!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Looking good!
That dynamism is on par with a top-class Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who set her sights on Taiki Shuttle was reporter Otonashi from Monthly Twinkle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Word has it that you have an exceptional eye
for discerning an Umamusume's abilities and future potential, but—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Phew... Did you get a nice shot, yes?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes, every single shot captures
Taiki Shuttle-san's power perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: The springiness, flexibility, and propulsion power in her strides... I am truly looking forward to what she does next.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to meee! I'll put on a grand show
and become "Horse Girl of the Year"!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Taiki Shuttle said that,
Reporter Otonashi's eyes widened in surprise.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Huh... But Taiki Shuttle-san's aptitude is for
“Sprint”, right?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
? Yesss, that is correct, BUT?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: No, um. Have you not heard?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume from the sprint division
has never once been selected as Umamusume of the Year.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: What!? Is that true, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
Yes... races like the Arima Kinen, Tenno Sho,
and Japan Cup naturally leave
a much stronger impression after all.

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
With sprint races offering limited opportunities
to shine, it's unavoidable...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The concerns Reporter Otonashi expressed
were the very same things I had worried about right after the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, Taiki Shuttle—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I see, I see, is that so, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: But—no problem!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"There is *nothing* in the rules saying you can't be chosen.
Is that okay?"

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Of course, there is no such regulation, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: In that case, what I must do does not change.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"If no one has ever done it before,
then I will be the first!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I'm the first sprinter to be Horse Girl of the Year! And that's all right by me!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Goodness...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the face of Taiki Shuttle's overwhelming spirit—
having no precedent is surely just a trivial detail.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It really made me realize that all over again...
choice_data_list: It's going to be a tough battle, but let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yeees! Leave it to meee!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hm? S?

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: It is wonderful!!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
A thorny path that no one has ever conquered...
Yet the two of you push forward without a single trace of hesitation!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Ah, if it's for an Umamusume's sake, you don't care about getting scratched by thorns or having hot sauce poured over your wounds—I'm so deeply moved by your dedication, Trainer~!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text:
"I'll keep following in the footsteps of you two!
Tracing your hoofprints of challenge! Every step of the way!!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you♪
Please, keep your eyes on me!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Deliver a fantastic dream
to big sis too—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I will make you happy, yes!

text_block_list.name: Reporter Otonashi
text_block_list.text: Fufu. Yes, I'm really looking forward to it!
